name: NAVIAI (Navigator 2)
summary: The humanoid from a Ningbo center founded in 2023 by the municipal government with Zhejiang University's Xiong Rong, and one of the few Chinese platforms with a large industrial order behind it — 2,000 units for sewing-machine maker Jack. Its arms hit 0.1 mm repeat positioning with 10 N fingertip force, and it walks at up to 6 km/h.
notable: 2,000-unit industrial order from sewing-machine maker Jack
